WHAT PET OWNERS ARE SAYING ABOUT THE CANCER CENTER AT AVCC
SCHEDULE A VISIT
“The doctors and nurses are incredibly compassionate and knowledgeable, and wait times are minimal. Highly recommend!”
Dr. Piscoya and the entire team have been fantastic. The doctors and nurses are incredibly compassionate and knowledgeable, and wait times are minimal. When my dog was diagnosed with cancer, Dr. Piscoya was exceptional—always responsive, providing clear treatment options, and truly making my dog’s care a priority. I couldn’t ask for a better experience during such a difficult time. Highly recommend!
~ Michael B. (Weston, FL)
“If you’re looking for a place that treats your pet like family while providing top-tier medical care, I wholeheartedly recommend the AVCC Cancer Center.”
I can’t begin to express my gratitude for the care my dog Jojo received from Dr. Piscoya and Brandy at the AVCC Cancer Center during his cancer diagnosis and treatment. From the moment I walked in, it was clear that Jojo was in the best hands. Dr. Piscoya took the time to explain everything with patience and compassion, ensuring that I understood all the options for Jojo’s treatment. Brandy, the oncology nurse, was equally amazing, always offering comfort and reassurance. Both went above and beyond to make me feel supported during an incredibly difficult time. The love and compassion they showed Jojo—and me—throughout this journey will forever be appreciated. If you’re looking for a place that treats your pet like family while providing top-tier medical care, I wholeheartedly recommend the AVCC Cancer Center. Thank you!
~ Nyrsa Z. (Miramar, FL)
“My dog came in with mast cell tumor removals. Dr. Piscoya (Oncology) and Dr. Arulpragasam (Surgeon) both went above and beyond to give my little one the best possible outcome.”
I can’t say enough good things about this place. My dog came in with mast cell tumor removals. Dr. Piscoya (Oncology) and Dr. Arulpragasam (Surgeon) both went above and beyond to give my little one the best possible outcome. They were understanding of my fears and panic, and really took the time to explain exactly what was happening and needed to be done. Thankfully my dog is on the mend and doing great. I absolutely appreciate the front desk staff, they are phenomenal in communicating and were so understanding, helpful, and patient. Even though they were extremely busy, I never felt looked over or taken advantage of.
~ Ava C. (Los Angeles, CA)
